description: Look at any PancakeSwap V3 liquidity position on BNB Chain, read from the chain: in range or not and how much room is left to each edge, what it holds and is worth in BNB, the fees it is owed and whether collecting them pays for the gas, and what PancakeSwap’s proposed The Flip (LPs keeping 88% of swap fees) would change for it - the share the pool pays its LPs today is read from the pool itself. Give a position id, or a wallet that holds one (a wallet with several gets their ids back). Free. What to do about it - whether a re-set is due and in which width - is the paid plan of the DeFi Agent (ERC-8004 #363709), 0.10 USD1 or half that in $BOBAI.

address.description: Or a wallet address that holds the position

position.description: A PancakeSwap V3 position id (the NFT token id), digits only
